data.name: Labyrinth: Shadows of the Kingdom
data.detailed_description:
Unleash the Legends in Mythics Unleashed

Battle corrupted factions, discover powerful Mythics, and restore the shattered realms in a fantasy action-adventure filled with combat, exploration, and legendary heroes.


Expand Your Roster with Mythic Character Packs

Unlock new playable Mythics through downloadable character packs on Steam, each bringing their own powers, playstyle, personality, and combat abilities to your adventure.


Upgrade Your Journey with the Founder’s Pack

Get extra Mythics, exclusive cosmetics, and bonus content designed for players who want to begin their adventure with even more legendary power.


Wishlist Mythics Unleashed Today

Follow the journey, stay updated on new reveals, and be ready to unleash legendary heroes when Mythics Unleashed arrives on Steam.


About the Game

The gates are broken. The legends have awakened.

In Mythics Unleashed, ancient heroes known as the Mythics return to a world on the brink of collapse. Once sealed away by the long-lost Wardens, these powerful champions must now rise again to stop The Veilbreaker and his armies of corruption from tearing the realms apart.

Step into the role of a new Warden and journey across a shattered world filled with forgotten ruins, cursed kingdoms, overgrown wilds, volcanic strongholds, sunken fortresses, and storm-torn skies. Along the way, you’ll discover and unlock powerful Mythics, each with their own combat style, elemental powers, personality, and traversal abilities.

Fight against the deadly forces of The Ruinbound — a brutal alliance of machine warlords, corrupted plant horrors, undead nobles, shadow assassins, abyssal raiders, and volcanic zealots — as you recover the lost Mythic Keys and uncover the truth behind the world’s greatest legend.

Master a growing roster of collectible heroes, unleash devastating powers, and forge a new bond between mortals and Mythics in a cinematic fantasy adventure where every champion changes how you fight and explore.

Features

  • Unlock and play as powerful Mythics with unique weapons, abilities, and elemental powers

  • Battle through a variety of vibrant worlds filled with secrets, enemies, puzzles, and bosses

  • Fight the Ruinbound factions, each with their own style, leaders, and deadly forces

  • Swap between legendary heroes to suit your playstyle and overcome different challenges

  • Explore a world shaped by ancient magic, forgotten technology, and fractured realms

  • Collect new Mythics through downloadable character packs and expand your roster over time

  • Experience a full story campaign with memorable allies, dangerous villains, and world-ending stakes

The world’s last hope isn’t one hero. It’s all of them.

Unleash the legends.
